name: airk
displayName: AIRK — Artifact Indexing and Retrieval Kernel (beta)
description: Pre-release beta: local collection indexing and specialized MCP evidence for coding agents, with a bundled native helper.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: AIRK requires workspace trust before starting its native helper or indexing files.

commands.title: AIRK: Manage Collections and Disk Space
AIRK: Show Local Usage and Estimated Savings

airk.storage.path.description: Absolute index folder on this extension host. Empty uses per-user extension storage. Changing it preserves old indexes and indexes the current workspace in the new location.

airk.storage.maxBytes.description: Soft collection-state budget in bytes. Zero disables it. Automatic indexing pauses at the budget; manual indexing can exceed it. No collection is deleted automatically.

airk.index.mode.description: Manual, after saves, after filesystem edits settle, or after editor activity settles.

airk.index.quietMs.description: Quiet period after filesystem edits for debounced indexing.

airk.index.idleMs.description: Required absence of editor activity in idle mode.

airk.index.maxDelayMs.description: Maximum batching delay for debounced/on-save changes, subject to minimum interval and pause/budget controls.

airk.index.minIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between automatic indexing jobs. Jobs run serially in each extension host.
